description: This file defines the ContentSearchSession class and its inner class ContentSearchOptions, handling search constraints, sorting, and view parameters for content within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for managing search parameters via session and request attributes, adding/removing constraints, setting sort order, and maintaining search history.

classes.name: ContentSearchSession
classes.description: Manages content search options, constraints, sorting, and view settings within user sessions. Provides static methods to process search parameters, maintain history, and manipulate search constraints.

classes.name: ContentSearchOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates search constraints, sort order, view index, and size. Supports serialization, copying, and utility methods to access and modify search criteria stored in session attributes.

methods.name: getContentSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the ContentSearchOptions object stored in session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes search parameters from request and updates the session's search constraints, sort order, and view settings accordingly.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the current session's search options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the current search session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Returns a list of previous search options stored in session for history purposes.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns descriptive strings of current search constraints for display or logging.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves current search options into history if they have changed since last time.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from current search constraints.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears all current search constraints and options.
